summary: Tiny walled-in lot of a few bays, reached through the neighbouring shop car park.
reasons: Enclosed by shops; homes 20 m or more away
Apartments 9 m from the south-east side

best_section.where: North end of the small lot, just inside the opening from the shop car park

drivers.seclusion: Retail walls on the west and south; nearest dwellings 20 m (residential) and 22 m (house) to the east, apartments 9 m on the far side.
drivers.access_and_room: Opens onto the adjoining car park; room for about three or four cars, a van would take most of the width.
drivers.traffic: Quiet back lot away from the street.
drivers.convention: Cars parked in the bays; looks like private shop or tenant parking, no sign of overnight stays.

flags: Apartments 9 m from the outline at 31 m along
DEM grade figures (11.9% mean) are distorted by roofs; the lot looks level
sun_shade: Open to sky; tall retail building to the west shades the afternoon, trees to the east.
cannot_judge: Private signage and whether it is permit parking
Whether a van fits the bays
